legacy_metadata_caveat.impact: Any selected variants retaining a generic default-only limitation would be listed here; an empty list means none were found. Actual numeric requests, selected metadata, GLB identity and cold frame joins are retained. No native shader/jiggle fidelity claim.

excluded: No model/GLB/HAS/PNG/audio/movie/runtime bytes copied. Native extra-feature motion/assembly/artist fidelity and the separate25worker-only passes are not inferred.
